''See also: [[Ozriel (Elder Empire) Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Ozriel is a figure from the [[Elder Empire]] associated with the [[Last Sea]]. Identified as the eighth [[Judge]] of the [[Court]] of Seven, he carries the title of the [[Destroyer]] and is described as the ultimate end for all existence. Though he maintains a human appearance and can appear lighthearted or relaxed, he possesses an unusual accent and immense power. He has expressed a desire to protect those in his presence, yet he has also threatened to erase entire worlds. Ozriel was originally sent with the mission to destroy a specific world, and he remains a figure poised to bring about total destruction. When prepared for combat, he is seen wearing black armor with long, pale hair and wielding a crackling scythe against the membrane that protects reality.}}

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Ozriel, an [[Outsider]] characterized by long white hair and smooth, liquid-like black armor, released his [[Intent]] during his appearance. Having previously met with [[Calder]] to converse through pure consciousness, he was described by [[Kelarac]] as a [[Furnace{{!}}furnace]] used for disposing of trash. While gazing across the abyss at [[Urg’naut]], Ozriel spoke regarding his duty to deal with things that escape. He eventually sent a message that was burned directly into the streets of the [[Capital]], revealing his identity as the [[Outsider]] who intends to kill everyone. To carry out his purposes, he wields a scythe that crackles against the blue membrane of reality.}}
